verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Pipedream provides official TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs plus a REST API for the Connect service. Code samples and documented Vercel AI SDK integration show developers building agents against Pipedream MCP in code. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference docs or installation details in the evidence, explicit evidence the SDKs cover MCP-specific workflows beyond Connect, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
